newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Tulip ends takeover talks with Commodore.
newsitem.headline: Tulip ends takeover talks with Commodore.

text.p: Dutch personal computer maker Tulip NV said on Monday it had ended talks about a possible takeover of Commodore BV after failing to reach an agreement.

Tulip had announced plans to take over Commodore BV at the end of June, saying it would issue some 30 million guilders' worth of shares to finance the deal which would have almost doubled Tulip's annual sales to around one billion guilders.
Commodore BV, based in Nieuw Vennep near Amsterdam, was spun off from Germany's bankrupt Escom computer group in a management buy-out last year. It makes PCs for the consumer market.
